explanation.it: HEAD ha restituito HTTP 200. Fallback GET saltato: HEAD non ha restituito 405/501. Trovata una policy frame-ancestors restrittiva o X-Frame-Options valida. Verifica le origini consentite rispetto alle esigenze applicative.

business_impact.en: Browser defense headers reduce specific client-side risks. Relevance depends on content, application behavior, and browser support.
business_impact.it: Le intestazioni di difesa browser riducono rischi specifici lato client. La rilevanza dipende da contenuti, applicazione e supporto browser.

remediation.en: For interactive HTML, configure CSP frame-ancestors with the intended embedding origins. Use 'none' only when embedding is unnecessary; X-Frame-Options DENY/SAMEORIGIN can support older clients.
remediation.it: Per HTML interattivo, configura CSP frame-ancestors con le origini di incorporamento previste. Usa 'none' solo se l'incorporamento non serve; X-Frame-Options DENY/SAMEORIGIN può supportare client meno recenti.

reason.en: Service requirements are unknown; relevance is conditional. No vulnerability is established by absence alone.
reason.it: I requisiti del servizio sono sconosciuti; la rilevanza è condizionale. La sola assenza non dimostra una vulnerabilità.

explanation.en: HTTP redirected to verified HTTPS within the permitted scope.
explanation.it: HTTP ha reindirizzato a HTTPS verificato nell'ambito consentito.

business_impact.en: Transport behavior affects browser access and exposure of an initial unencrypted request.
business_impact.it: Il comportamento del trasporto influisce sull'accesso browser e sull'esposizione della prima richiesta non cifrata.

remediation.en: If HTTP serves this browser-facing site, review a canonical HTTPS redirect with the web operator. Do not open port 80 merely to clear an inconclusive check; closure can be intentional. Confirm intended routing before changes.
remediation.it: Se HTTP serve questo sito destinato ai browser, valuta con il gestore un redirect HTTPS canonico. Non aprire la porta 80 solo per eliminare una verifica inconcludente; la chiusura può essere intenzionale. Conferma l'instradamento previsto prima delle modifiche.

reason.en: An HTTP response established the observed upgrade/plaintext behavior for this URL only.
reason.it: Una risposta HTTP ha accertato il comportamento di passaggio a HTTPS o in chiaro solo per questo URL.

score_formula: Profile context-v1: 100 × passed / (passed + failed), using explicitly scoreable and applicable checks only. All optional browser headers, warnings, unknowns, errors and findings with unknown or no applicability are excluded. Coverage and profile must accompany comparisons; historical scores use their original profile. This is not a probability of compromise or a security guarantee.
methodology: DNS uses the configured recursive resolver, bounded queries and only supplied DKIM selectors. DMARC uses explicitly labeled legacy RFC 7489 PSL/pct interpretation; current RFC 9989 tree-walk/testing semantics are not implemented. Records with np/psd/t remain inconclusive. Sender alignment and reporting delivery are not tested. SPF checks common syntax and potential lookup paths, not full sender-dependent evaluation. CAA is inspected only at the exact name. One TLS handshake verifies the requested hostname and chain using the local trust store; obsolete protocol support, revocation and CT are not probed. HTTP uses HEAD on ports 80/443 and, only with explicit opt-in after HTTPS HEAD 405/501, a GET fallback. HTTPS connectivity does not establish application availability; security headers require a final HTTPS 2xx response. Both methods use validated public IPs and bounded same-organizational-domain redirects. GET can cause application side effects even when only headers are read. Bodies and HTML meta policies are not inspected. Headers reflect the final successful response, possibly a CDN. Only one selected IP is sampled. Saved web evidence uses a header allowlist and redacts URL queries, credentials and fragments; paths and DNS records can still be sensitive. Failures and blocked requests are unknown, not confirmed vulnerabilities. Ownership is a user declaration, not independently verified.
disclaimer: This assessment is not a penetration test, audit certification, compliance attestation, or guarantee of security. It cannot establish the security of an organization or the probability of compromise. Assess only assets you own or are explicitly authorized to review.
